name: Egypt
introduction: I am Horus in human flesh — Hatshepsut, pharaoh of the red lands and the black lands.
declaringWar: When we are done, the lone and level sands will be all that remains of you.
attacked: The nau-snake is in my belly, and I have not given myself to you, your flame will not be on me.
defeated: Open the Netherworld so that I may see my father Osiris. All you spirits, prepare a path for me.

name: China
startIntroPart1: Great Matriarch of China, Wu Zetian..
introduction: I am Wu Zetian, loved and feared by the people, the only queen in all of China
declaringWar: My dear, the time has come for you to go.
attacked: Here come a bunch of men waving swords around and shouting. Or am I supposed to call this mess an 'art'?
defeated: Please... I'm sure we could work something out. This doesn't have to be the end... does it?
denounced: Your words are sharp. Other things are sharper.

name: India
introduction: I am Chandragupta, Mauryan emperor of unified India. No, it has not gone to my head.
declaringWar: Your territory could be much improved under Indian rule. Best I see it through.
attacked: India does not fear war. The most you can do is slow our rightful advance.
defeated: You learned my own lessons far too well. I instructed you in my own demise.
denounced: Though I ignore your cruel words, India will long remember them.

name: Babylon
introduction: I fill my storehouses with grain and my wells with water. The gods bless my name: Hammurabi.
declaringWar: I have broken the walls of Adab and Nippur in war. Thus I shall break your cities.
attacked: Who are you to oppose Hammurabi? You are dust, mere dirt I shake from my sandals.
defeated: Anu! Answer your servant! Why have you allowed my defeat?
denounced: Lawless vulture! It is only by my great mercy that I still speak with you.

name: Japan
introduction: I am Tokugawa Ieyasu, shōgun of Japan. Nothing happens here without my say.
declaringWar: The sharp-edged sword cuts through the void, and within the raging fire, a cool wind blows.
attacked: Be careful and come at me! I'll wait for your unguarded point.
defeated: The summer grasses are all that remains of warriors' dreams.
denounced: We can manage our own affairs. Without you.

name: France
startIntroPart1: Holy King of the Franks, Charlemagne..
introduction: I am Charles, known as Charlemagne. While others rule by the sword, I rule by the grace of God. And also the sword.
declaringWar: My fury is upon you. None shall escape.
attacked: The blades of the righteous, the banner of heaven. It is you who should fear.
defeated: With this, I must cast my crown aside, to be washed in the tears of the faithful and God's own holy rain.

name: England
introduction: Greetings. We are by the Grace of God, Victoria, Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. And soon, dare I say, the empire.
declaringWar: As our protests are in vain, we hereby declare war.
defeated: This severe and afflicting loss will not be sustained, and England, thank providence, will ascend again.
denounced: You tread on dangerous waters in the face of England and her loyal colonies.
